answer_1.quote: We transform free-text chest X-ray radiology reports into a standardized format using deep learning.
answer_1.outputs: structured radiology reports with sections: Exam Type, History, Technique, Comparison, Findings, and Impression

answer_2.quote: To assess both linguistic quality and clinical accuracy, we use a combination of lexical and radiology-specific metrics.

answer_3.quote: GREEN assesses the factual correctness of generated radiology reports using a finetuned LLM.
methods: factual correctness assessment using finetuned LLM

answer_4.quote: Five board-certified radiologists from our institution reviewed the structured reports alongside their original freeform counterparts, assessing them for errors and adherence to our predefined template
answer_4.guideline: assessing them for errors and adherence to our predefined template
